sentences.en: But I think we both kind of check it out every now and then, but not.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得我们俩平时还是会偶尔看看，虽然也不算经常。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't watch it that much.
sentences.zh: 对，我其实不怎么看。

sentences.en: I feel like it's more inclusive.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它现在包容性更强了。

sentences.en: I mean, I just know the staff and the cast feels a little more inclusive than in our era.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，据我所知，现在的幕后团队和演员阵容比我们那个时代更有包容性。

sentences.en: That's changed.
sentences.zh: 这一点变了。

sentences.en: For sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: To echo Will's point, I've always said this.
sentences.zh: 呼应一下威尔的观点，我一直都这么说。

sentences.en: There are two or three good sketches every show, sometimes just one, and the rest of them are shit.
sentences.zh: 每集节目里有两三个好小品，有时甚至只有一个，剩下的全都是垃圾。

sentences.en: However, we all don't agree on what those three sketches are.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于到底哪三个小品算好，我们大家的看法并不一致。

sentences.en: Go back and watch a whole show from 78.
sentences.zh: 你回去看看78年整整一期的节目。

sentences.en: There's a bunch of shit.
sentences.zh: 里面有一堆垃圾。

sentences.en: It's very meandering.
sentences.zh: 非常漫长乏味。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And there's some classics.
sentences.zh: 而且也有一些经典。

sentences.en: And there's some, right.
sentences.zh: 而且也有一些，没错。

sentences.en: And so that's what I think every era does.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我觉得每个时代都会有的情况。

sentences.en: You mentioned that the show is more inclusive now.
sentences.zh: 你提到现在这个节目的包容性更强了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And that seems to be inarguable.
sentences.zh: 而这似乎是毋庸置疑的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But do you ever think back to material, this is for both of you guys, material that you wrote or were in and thought, well,
sentences.zh: 但你们俩有没有回想过以前的素材，不管是你们自己写的还是参演过的，然后心想，嗯，

sentences.en: that was a bad way into that joke or I wouldn't have handled that subject.
sentences.zh: 那个笑话的切入点真烂，或者我不该那样处理那个话题。

sentences.en: Like that today?
sentences.zh: 就像现在这样？

sentences.en: Is there anything that sort of makes you cringe a little?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么东西会让你觉得有点尴尬或难为情？

sentences.en: A good third of my comedy, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我的喜剧里大概有足足三分之一吧，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I would say I wouldn't write that today or I wouldn't handle it that way today.
sentences.zh: 对，我会说我今天绝不会那样写，或者我今天绝不会那样处理。

sentences.en: No, there were a few times even while seeing the sketch mounted, I would go, ugh.
sentences.zh: 不，甚至在看到小品排练的时候，我就有好几次心里直犯嘀咕，呃。

sentences.en: And I think that that is a fear-based thing where you feel like you've got to please an audience or you're losing your job and you make a decision that is not – I can't say this for Will.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一种出于恐惧的心理，你会觉得你必须讨好观众，否则就会丢掉饭碗，于是你做出了一个并非——我不能代表威尔这么说。

sentences.en: I feel like he was more secure in who he was.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他对自己的认识要坚定得多。

sentences.en: But for me, I probably felt a lot of fear, imposter syndrome.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，我可能感受到了很多恐惧和冒名顶替综合征。

sentences.en: I might have overstepped bounds that even I was – I know I did.
sentences.zh: 我可能越界了，甚至连我自己——我知道我确实这么做了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think I'd have to go back and actually review shows and – but I'm sure there'd be a fair amount where you'd lament the choice or – I mean, in a way, the cast,
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得我得回去重新看一遍以前的节目，而且——但我敢肯定，会有相当一部分内容让你对当初的选择感到懊悔，或者——我的意思是，在某种程度上，作为演员阵容，

sentences.en: you're kind of given this assignment.
sentences.zh: 你基本上是接到这样一份任务。

sentences.en: So you're – so I'm going to blame the writers.
sentences.zh: 所以你——所以我打算把责任推给编剧。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He's not culpable at all.
sentences.zh: 他可是一点责任都没有。

sentences.en: Just following orders.
sentences.zh: 只是奉命行事罢了。

sentences.en: But yeah, I mean, I think that's the nature of the show.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，我的意思是，我觉得这就是这个节目的本质。

sentences.en: I wrote Monica Lewinsky stuff I wasn't proud of.
sentences.zh: 我写过莫妮卡·莱温斯基相关的段子，对此我并不感到骄傲。

sentences.en: I wrote some good Britney stuff and some stuff that I'm not as proud of, you know, Britney Spears.
sentences.zh: 我写过一些不错的关于布兰妮的段子，也有一些让我没那么骄傲的段子，你知道的，布兰妮·斯皮尔斯。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I wrote some Clinton things I wasn't proud of.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我写过一些关于克林顿的东西，我并不引以为豪。

sentences.en: Yeah, I would not approach it in the same way at all, and I don't.
sentences.zh: 是的，我绝对不会用同样的方式去处理，现在也不会。

sentences.en: So, you know, I'm just moving on.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我只是在往前看。

sentences.en: I have to.
sentences.zh: 我必须如此。

sentences.en: The Janet Reno character hits a false note now.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特·雷诺那个角色现在听起来有点不合时宜了。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's something, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，那确实是，对。

sentences.en: I wouldn't choose to do now and –
sentences.zh: 我现在不会选择去那样做了，而且——

sentences.en: This kind of bums me out, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，这事儿让我有点沮丧。

sentences.en: This is something that I actually feel a little bit differently about it.
sentences.zh: 这是我其实有不同看法的一件事。

sentences.en: I understand the laugh is a drag laugh.
sentences.zh: 我理解那种笑声是一种低级趣味的笑声。

sentences.en: It's the, hey, look at this guy.
sentences.zh: 就是那种，嘿，快看这家伙。

sentences.en: He's got a new dress and that's funny.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一条新裙子，这太好笑了。

sentences.en: And it's absolutely not funny.
sentences.zh: 而这绝对一点都不好笑。

sentences.en: It's absolutely a way that we should be able to live in the world.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是我们在这个世界上本该能够拥有的生活方式。

sentences.en: However, with performers and actors, I do like a sense of play.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于表演者和演员来说，我确实挺喜欢那种游戏心态的。

sentences.en: I do think people should play with characters.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为人们应该敢于扮演各种角色。

sentences.en: This is an interesting question to me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说这是一个很有意思的问题。

sentences.en: Do queer people like the birdcage or do they not like it?
sentences.zh: 酷儿群体是喜欢《鸟笼》这部电影还是讨厌它？

sentences.en: Robin Williams, at least as far as we know, was not a gay man.
sentences.zh: 罗宾·威廉姆斯，至少据我们所知，并不是一个同性恋男性。

sentences.en: And yet he spent about a half of his comedy career doing a swishy gay guy on camera.
sentences.zh: 然而他大约有一半的喜剧生涯都是在镜头前扮演娘娘腔的同性恋男子。

sentences.en: Do people think that that's funny or is it just hurtful?
sentences.zh: 人们觉得这很有趣，还是说这仅仅是一种伤害？

sentences.en: And I've heard from gay men that it was funny and I've heard from gay men that it was very hurtful.
sentences.zh: 我听有些同性恋男士说这很有趣，我也听有些同性恋男士说这非常具有伤害性。

sentences.en: And I understand both.
sentences.zh: 这两种观点我都理解。

sentences.en: I just – sometimes I wonder if – and I'm the most woke.
sentences.zh: 我只是——有时我在想，如果——而且我是最清醒的那拨人。

sentences.en: I am accusably purple-haired woke.
sentences.zh: 我就是那种会被人指责为一头紫发极左觉醒派的人。

sentences.en: I'm telling you.
sentences.zh: 我跟你说真的。

sentences.en: But I do wonder if sometimes we take away the joy of playing when we take away some of the range that some performers, especially comedy performers, can do.
sentences.zh: 但我确实在想，有时当我们剥夺了某些演员（尤其是喜剧演员）所能展现的表演跨度时，我们是不是也剥夺了表演的乐趣。

sentences.en: So now I've got some questions about the movie.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我有一些关于这部电影的问题。

sentences.en: Harper, you say in the film that one of the things you've always loved to do is sort of take these cross-country drives.
sentences.zh: 哈珀，你在片中提到，你一直以来最喜欢做的事情之一就是进行这种跨国驾车旅行。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Just explore the country by yourself.
sentences.zh: 就是独自一人探索这个国家。

sentences.en: And you like to go out of the way bars and diners and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 而且你喜欢去那些偏僻的酒吧、小餐馆之类的地方。

sentences.en: Whose idea was it that Will would go along with you on your first of these cross-country drives after transitioning?
sentences.zh: 在你变性之后的第一次这种跨国自驾游中，是谁的主意让威尔跟你一起同行的？

sentences.en: Well, it was Will's idea.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是威尔的主意。

sentences.en: Most definitely it was Will's idea.
sentences.zh: 绝对是威尔的主意。

sentences.en: I wouldn't have never thought of something like that.
sentences.zh: 我绝不可能想到这种事。

sentences.en: But nor when he suggested it to me did I think it was a good idea.
sentences.zh: 但当他向我提议时，我也没有觉得这是一个好主意。

sentences.en: So it took a little bit of a thought process for me a couple months before I actually thought, well, there might be something here.
sentences.zh: 所以我花了一段时间去思考，在成行前的几个月里，我才终于觉得，嗯，这或许可行。

sentences.en: It wasn't my first time crossing as Harper.
sentences.zh: 这不是我第一次以哈珀的身份跨越国境。

sentences.en: However, I crossed, but I was intensely fearful.
sentences.zh: 然而，虽然我跨越了，但我内心极度恐惧。

sentences.en: Like I would stay in, I slept in my truck, which is something I did all the time anyway.
sentences.zh: 比如我会待在车里，我睡在自己的卡车上，反正这也是我一直都在做的事。

sentences.en: And I would not go into like my favorite kinds of places, the restaurants, the truck stops, the bars.
sentences.zh: 而且我根本不敢去我最喜欢的那类地方，比如餐馆、卡车休息站、酒吧。

sentences.en: I didn't do any of that.
sentences.zh: 我什么都没去。

sentences.en: But I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道。

sentences.en: So it was a different thing with Will.
sentences.zh: 所以和威尔一起去是完全不同的一种体验。

sentences.en: So, Will, can you explain to me what your thinking was?
sentences.zh: 那么，威尔，你能向我解释一下你当时的考虑吗？

sentences.en: I mean, if Harper said initially she wasn't jazzed about the idea, what was your sort of pitch to her about why to do it?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果哈珀最初说她对这个想法不怎么感冒，你当时是怎么向她推销这个提议并劝她去做的？

sentences.en: I don't really know.
sentences.zh: 我其实也不知道。

sentences.en: Because I told her, like, I'm not trying to exploit our friendship.
sentences.zh: 因为我告诉过她，听着，我不是想利用我们的友谊。

sentences.en: Please, I hope you know that.
sentences.zh: 求你了，我希望你知道这一点。

sentences.en: But this is a crazy enough idea, like, and by the way, this is all, this is the first time we'd seen each other.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个足够疯狂的想法，而且顺便说一句，这也是我们俩重聚后第一次见面。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.en: We were having coffee in my backyard and it's, we're both nervous, you know.
sentences.zh: 我们在我后院喝咖啡，你知道的，我们俩都很紧张。

sentences.en: So we're sitting down and we're kind of like, how's it been going?
sentences.zh: 所以我们坐下来，差不多就在说，最近过得怎么样？

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Just catching up.
sentences.zh: 就是叙叙旧。

sentences.en: And that's when I kind of sprung out on her.
sentences.zh: 然后我就差不多在这个时候把这个想法抛给了她。

sentences.en: Where I, because I'd heard from a mutual friend of ours that she was lamenting the fact that I don't know if I can do these same type of road trips the way I used to.
sentences.zh: 当时是因为我从我们的一位共同朋友那里听说，她一直在遗憾地说，我不知道自己还能不能像以前那样进行这种公路旅行了。

sentences.en: And I said to Harper, what if we went on a road trip?
sentences.zh: 于是我对哈珀说，我们去进行一次公路旅行怎么样？

sentences.en: I went with you and we film it.
sentences.zh: 我陪你一起去，我们把过程拍下来。

sentences.en: And I'll be kind of like your offensive lineman, so to speak.
sentences.zh: 而且我差不多会充当你的进攻截锋，这么说吧。

sentences.en: And, you know, a chance for me to actually kind of ask all the questions that I have.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这也是一个让我有机会真正提出我所有疑问的机会。

sentences.en: And we can kind of examine what's changed, what's not.
sentences.zh: 我们可以借此探讨一下什么变了，什么没变。

sentences.en: But I totally get it if you don't want to.
sentences.zh: 但如果你不愿意，我完全理解。

sentences.en: And I, but I think Harper finally landed on the square that we could help people possibly.
sentences.zh: 不过，我觉得哈珀最终认同了这样一个观念，那就是我们这样做可能可以帮助到别人。

sentences.en: But I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但我也说不准。

sentences.en: It didn't come from a social justice warrior kind of place at all.
sentences.zh: 这完全不是出于什么社会正义战士的心态。

sentences.en: I mean, we're both producers and writers and he's kind of an actor.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们俩都是制片人和编剧，而他算是个演员。

sentences.en: I'm a mid-level.
sentences.zh: 我是个中等水平的。

sentences.en: Mid-level.
sentences.zh: 中等水平。

sentences.en: I'm either a mid-level A-lister or I'm a top-tier B-list actor.
sentences.zh: 我要么是个中等水平的一线演员，要么是个顶尖的二线演员。

sentences.en: We both create a lot of shit.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都创作了很多烂东西。

sentences.en: And so.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: I'm falling to top-tier B-list as the years go on.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我正逐渐沦为顶尖二线。

sentences.en: Yes, I'll take that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我接受这个评价。

sentences.en: Get the paycheck still.
sentences.zh: 照样能拿支票。

sentences.en: Well, no, I think we both make a lot of crap.
sentences.zh: 好吧，不，我觉得我们俩都创作了很多垃圾。

sentences.en: So I think that's how we think sometimes, too.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这也是我们有时思考问题的方式。

sentences.en: Just like we want to go do something fun.
sentences.zh: 就像我们只想去做点好玩的事。

sentences.en: What can we make out of it?
sentences.zh: 我们能从中创作出什么呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I just think that's part of our process.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这是我们创作流程的一部分。

sentences.en: But I had to talk myself into doing it.
sentences.zh: 但我得先说服自己去做这件事。

sentences.en: Again,
sentences.zh: 再说一次，

sentences.en: I can't really pin down the mode of there is a social justice part of this because I'm reading the newspaper every day and more and more trans bills are being offered up to every state in the country.
sentences.zh: 我无法确切地指出其中包含社会正义的成分，因为我每天都在看报纸，看到全国各个州都在出台越来越多的跨性别法案。

sentences.en: And it's making me think like, well, you're a fucking old lady.
sentences.zh: 这让我觉得，好吧，你这个老太婆。

sentences.en: You can do something.
sentences.zh: 你总得做点什么。

sentences.en: And so I'm thinking about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我在考虑这个。

sentences.en: But then I'm also thinking like, hey, I would like to go across the country with the best bodyguard of all time who everyone wants to meet and love.
sentences.zh: 但同时我又在想，嘿，我想和有史以来最棒、人人都想见、人人都喜欢的保镖一起横跨全国。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a little cowardly, but that's, yeah, I want to do that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这有点像当缩头乌龟，但对，我就是想这么做。

sentences.en: So the motives are all, you know, they're everywhere.
sentences.zh: 所以这些动机各种各样，你知道的，非常杂乱。

sentences.en: I did think, like, if you had been traveling with someone who wasn't recognizable, there would have been, I assume, a lot more anonymity.
sentences.zh: 我确实在想，如果你和一个不出名的人一起旅行，我猜匿名性会高得多。

sentences.en: Traveling around with Will Ferrell, you know, isn't exactly an unmediated experience.
sentences.zh: 而和威尔·法瑞尔一起到处旅行，你知道的，可算不上是什么不受打扰的纯粹体验。

sentences.en: Did you feel like there was any tension in that idea at all for you?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这个想法对你来说哪怕有一点点压力吗？

sentences.en: It's hard to say.
sentences.zh: 这很难说。

sentences.en: Probably not because I've been around Will for 30 years, you know.
sentences.zh: 可能没有，因为我已经跟威尔相处了30年了，你知道的。

sentences.en: And so that part felt comfortable.
sentences.zh: 所以那部分感觉很自然舒适。

sentences.en: I know, I don't, I didn't see any of the negative side effects except for, obviously, you know,
sentences.zh: 我知道，我没有，我没有看到任何负面影响，除了很显然的，你知道的，

sentences.en: we show in the film a few places where social media is responding to us and they wouldn't respond to me and some other non-celebrity friend of mine at all.
sentences.zh: 我们在片中展示了一些地方，那里社交媒体对我们的反应，如果是针对我和我其他非名人朋友，是绝对不会有这种反应的。

sentences.en: You know, they wouldn't, that wouldn't come up.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们不会，这种事情根本不会发生。

sentences.en: They've got, Will is putting a spotlight on this whole thing.
sentences.zh: 他们让威尔来聚焦这整件事。

sentences.en: So you've got people calling me the best, the wonderful,
sentences.zh: 所以有人叫我最棒的、绝妙的、

sentences.en: the best possible names that they can come up with there in their basements because they don't have any time to do anything else constructive.
sentences.zh: 他们能在地下室里想出的各种最好的词来骂我，因为他们没有时间去做其他任何建设性的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: Whatever.
sentences.zh: 随便吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I love them all.
sentences.zh: 我爱他们所有人。

sentences.en: So there's one scene in particular in the film.
sentences.zh: 所以电影里有一个特别的场景。

sentences.en: Uh-oh.
sentences.zh: 噢噢。

sentences.en: It takes place at a steakhouse in Amarillo, Texas.
sentences.zh: 发生在德克萨斯州阿马里洛的一家牛排馆。

sentences.en: That's the one you just referred to where, you know, after I think people were saying some pretty nasty things on social media.
sentences.zh: 这就是你刚才提到的那个，你知道的，我想是在大家在社交媒体上说了一些相当难听的话之后。

sentences.en: And so that scene happens and, you know, it's an upsetting experience.
sentences.zh: 然后那个场景就发生了，你知道的，这是一次令人心烦的经历。

sentences.en: And then in the car after, Will, you say you felt like you let Harper down.
sentences.zh: 然后在那之后的车里，威尔，你说你觉得你让哈珀失望了。

sentences.en: Can you sort of unpack that a little bit for me?
sentences.zh: 你能为我稍微剖析一下这一点吗？

sentences.en: You let her down in the sense that you weren't able to diffuse the tension in that moment or, or that you invited that moment at all?
sentences.zh: 你觉得辜负了她，是因为你当时没能化解紧张气氛，还是说，你根本就是自找的？

sentences.en: Kind of, yeah, I think both of those, you know, didn't really have a grasp on how intense it was going to be.
sentences.zh: 算是吧，对，我觉得两者都有，你知道的，当时真的没料到会那么激烈。

sentences.en: Um, and, yeah, I was, I felt like we just didn't, um, yeah, we didn't do our due diligence and we found ourselves in this, this situation that was,
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，对，我当时觉得我们就是没有，嗯，对，我们没有尽到尽职调查的义务，结果发现自己陷入了这样一个，这样一个局面，

sentences.en: felt like it was going to be just this benign kind of, you know, uh, place where you eat a big steak in the amount of time.
sentences.zh: 感觉这本来只是一个温和的、你知道的，呃，可以大口吃牛排的地方。

sentences.en: And then you walk in and it's a thousand people seated in this room.
sentences.zh: 然后你走进去，房间里坐了一千个人。

sentences.en: And, and I was like, oh, why, why are we here?
sentences.zh: 而且，而且我就想，哦，为什么，我们为什么在这？

sentences.en: Also just to paint the picture for people, you were dressed as Sherlock Holmes.
sentences.zh: 另外，为了给听众们还原一下画面，你当时穿着福尔摩斯的衣服。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I, exactly.
sentences.zh: 而我，完全没错。

sentences.en: I'm like, that was a bad choice too.
sentences.zh: 我心想，这也是个糟糕的选择。

sentences.en: And I thought, I thought it was going to be, I thought it was going to be so fun.
sentences.zh: 我本以为，我本以为这会非常有趣。

sentences.en: Do you think the people in the restaurant thought you were making fun of them somehow?
sentences.zh: 你觉得餐馆里的人以为你在某种程度上是在取笑他们吗？

sentences.en: Like that you tried to turn the thing into a spectacle?
sentences.zh: 就像你试图把这事变成一场闹剧一样？

sentences.en: Like why were the vibes so off there?
sentences.zh: 为什么那里的气氛会这么诡异？

sentences.en: Uh, well, you're up, you know, you're just up on this raised platform and I, I mean, the vibes were just so off, uh, because to put it bluntly, there was a trans woman sitting.
sentences.zh: 呃，好吧，你站在上面，你知道的，你只是站在那个高高的平台上，我的意思是，气氛之所以那么诡异，呃，直白点说，是因为当时坐着一个跨性别女性。

sentences.en: Next to Sherlock Holmes.
sentences.zh: 就坐在福尔摩斯旁边。

sentences.en: To your earlier question, I would say that was a moment where the Will Ferrell factor actually worked against me.
sentences.zh: 对于你之前的问题，我想说那是“威尔·费瑞尔效应”反而对我产生负面影响的一个时刻。

sentences.en: Because that was a fishbowl and the room was really zeroing in on a lot of photographs, a lot of selfies, a lot of, and, um, and,
sentences.zh: 因为那是个鱼缸式的环境，整个房间都在高度聚焦于大量的照片、大量的自拍、大量的事情，而且，嗯，而且，

sentences.en: and I was sitting up there on a sort of on display and, um, here, I'll say something that wasn't in the doc.
sentences.zh: 而且我坐在上面，就像是被公开展览一样，嗯，来吧，我说点纪录片里没有的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Um, we gave a little toast and, um, it was funny and, um, I said something about passing a trans bill.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们做了一个小祝酒，嗯，挺搞笑的，嗯，我说了一些关于通过一项跨性别法案的事。

sentences.en: And the room did a kind of reversal and a little bit of a boo and I pulled myself out of it and a woman shouted out, we still love you.
sentences.zh: 结果全场的气氛突然逆转，还发出了一点嘘声，我赶紧调整好自己，然后一个女人大喊道，我们依然爱你。

sentences.en: And, um, I hate the phrase.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，我很讨厌这个词。

sentences.en: I could be misinterpreting this woman completely, but this is the feeling I had in the room.
sentences.zh: 我可能完全误解了这个女人，但这就是我在现场时的感受。

sentences.en: But it felt condescending for sure.
sentences.zh: 但这绝对让人觉得居高临下。

sentences.en: The still, it's the conditional.
sentences.zh: 依然，这是一个条件句。

sentences.en: You still love me.
sentences.zh: 你依然爱我。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: When I finally give up being trans and give over my life over to Christ, I, then I'm worthy of, then they will love me more and I will have hidden a bit.
sentences.zh: 等我终于放弃做跨性别者、把生命交托给基督之后，我，那我才配得上，然后他们才会更爱我，而我也会把真实的自己藏起来一部分。

sentences.en: But they still love me even though I'm, uh, uh, some kind of a sinner or something.
sentences.zh: 但尽管我是一个，呃，呃，某种罪人或什么的，他们依然爱我。

sentences.en: I felt that.
sentences.zh: 我有这种感觉。

sentences.en: And, and I, I, I, I think I kind of wished I'd walked in and said, oh no, this is going to be terrible.
sentences.zh: 而且，而且我，我，我，我真希望当时自己走进去时说，哦不，这太糟糕了。

sentences.en: Let's just go.
sentences.zh: 我们走吧。

sentences.en: Why are, why are we here?
sentences.zh: 为什么，我们为什么在这？

sentences.en: Now, we both kind of stuck it out because, you know, I guess it's the function of having cameras there and we're making this thing.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们俩还是坚持了下来，因为，你知道的，我想这是因为有摄像机在那里，而且我们在拍这个东西。

sentences.en: And this is one of the places we were talked about going.
sentences.zh: 这是我们讨论过要去的地点之一。

sentences.en: So we need to follow through.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要贯彻到底。

sentences.en: And it leads to one of the more compelling sections of, of the piece.
sentences.zh: 这引领了这部作品中更引人入胜的片段之一。

sentences.en: But yeah, that's, I think that I was just feeling that remorse and guilt of, of, of even going there.
sentences.zh: 但对，这就是，我想我当时只是感到了那种后悔和愧疚，甚至后悔去那里。

sentences.en: I want to go back to another moment in the film that, um, I don't know if tense is the right word, but it's sort of the implications of it were interesting.
sentences.zh: 我想回到电影中的另一个时刻，嗯，我不知道“紧张”是不是合适的词，但它的某种潜台词很有意思。

sentences.en: It's, so you guys go to a, an Indiana Pacers game.
sentences.zh: 就是，你们去了一场印第安纳步行者队的比赛。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You have courtside seats and during the game, or I don't know if it's after the game, but while you're at the game, the, uh,
sentences.zh: 你们坐在场边席，比赛期间，或者我不知道是不是赛后，但在你看球的时候，呃，

sentences.en: governor Holcomb of Indiana comes up to you and basically does a, a little photo op.
sentences.zh: 印第安纳州长霍尔科姆走到你面前，基本上就是搞了一次小小的作秀拍照。

sentences.en: And then after the game, I guess it's the next day or something, you guys are trying to figure out what his stance on trans issues were.
sentences.zh: 然后比赛结束后，我想是第二天左右吧，你们在琢磨他对于跨性别问题的立场到底是什么。

sentences.en: And it turns out he doesn't have the most progressive stance on them.
sentences.zh: 结果发现他对这些问题的立场并不是最进步的。

sentences.en: And, and, you know, it sort of feels in the, in the film, like, you know, you, you guys are wondering whether you should have taken the photo,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，在电影里感觉就像是，你知道的，你们在想当时到底该不该拍那张照片，

sentences.en: if there was a missed opportunity in some sense to, to not raise something with him.
sentences.zh: 在某种意义上，是不是错失了一个没有向他提出质疑的机会。

sentences.en: Um, did you think about like trying to go back to him or, or trying to talk to state politicians or, cause it didn't necessarily have to be like a one and done, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你有想过去找他，或者试着跟州政客谈谈吗？因为这不一定非得是一锤子买卖，对吧？

sentences.en: I guess it didn't.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: No, that didn't come up.
sentences.zh: 没有，没谈过这事。

sentences.en: It would have been interesting.
sentences.zh: 那应该会很有趣。

sentences.en: I'm sure.
sentences.zh: 我确信。

sentences.en: Um, yeah, it would have been interesting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对，那会很有趣。

sentences.en: Um, it would have been a little more confrontational than we had planned.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那会比我们计划的更具对抗性一点。

sentences.en: Um, but yeah, that, that, that maybe we can go back for part two.
sentences.zh: 不过对，那，也许我们可以拍第二部时再回去找他。

sentences.en: I, I think what we both, what I felt there, maybe even more than will, because we'll guess it all the time, is a little bit of an ambushing.
sentences.zh: 我想我们俩，我在那里感受到的，甚至可能比威尔还要多，因为威尔经常遇到这种事，就是有点像遭到了伏击。

sentences.en: Sometimes at SNL, you'd be walking through the hall.
sentences.zh: 有时候在《周六夜现场》里，你会走过大厅。

sentences.en: And I remember walking through the hall and Donald Rumsfeld was there and he stuck his hand out and I shook his hand and I was like, oh, I don't think I like you.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次走过大厅，唐纳德·拉姆斯菲尔德在那里，他伸出了手，我跟他握了握手，当时我就想，哦，我想我不太喜欢你。

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 后来怎么了？

sentences.en: Another thing that we didn't include in the doc at all.
sentences.zh: 另一件我们在纪录片里完全没剪进去的事。

sentences.en: Oh, it's sweet.
sentences.zh: 哦，这太贴心了。

sentences.en: is how lovely and supportive Rick Carlisle was, the coach of the Pacers.
sentences.zh: 就是步行者队教练里克·卡莱尔是多么可爱和支持我们。

sentences.en: Because we have all this, we meet everyone kind of before the game starts and he literally pulled you aside and was like, congratulations, like, this is great.
sentences.zh: 因为我们把所有这些，我们在比赛开始前见到了所有人，他 literalmente（字面意思：真的）把你拉到一边说，恭喜啊，这太棒了。

sentences.en: I wish you the best and congrats.
sentences.zh: 我祝你一切顺利，恭喜。

sentences.en: Like, he couldn't have been sweeter, couldn't have been.
sentences.zh: 真的，他不能再友善了，不可能更好了。

sentences.en: That could have been what the governor said.
sentences.zh: 州长要是能这么说就好了。

sentences.en: That would have been neat.
sentences.zh: 那可就太好了。

sentences.en: Yeah, the governor did not quite say that.
sentences.zh: 对，州长可没这么说。

sentences.en: And in your heart of hearts, do you have, like, a goal for the movie?
sentences.zh: 在你内心深处，你对这部电影有什么目标吗？

sentences.en: Do you want it to change people's feelings or make them rethink their politics?
sentences.zh: 你是想改变人们的感受，还是让他们重新思考自己的政治立场？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I think that's, I think that's, in the end, that's why we did it.
sentences.zh: 我想那是，我想这才是我们最终拍这部电影的原因。

sentences.en: It's a funny movie.
sentences.zh: 这是一部有趣的电影。

sentences.en: Will is a funny guy.
sentences.zh: 威尔是个有趣的人。

sentences.en: And, you know, when he asked me to do the project, he was very clear, I don't want to make an opportunity out of our friendship.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，当他邀请我参与这个项目时，他非常明确地表示，我不想利用我们的友谊来谋求利益。

sentences.en: On the other end of that, I did want to make an opportunity out of my friendship.
sentences.zh: 从另一方面来说，我确实想利用我们的友谊来谋求利益。

sentences.en: I want to be very clear about something, though, that I get in trouble with, I think, with myself personally.
sentences.zh: 不过，我想明确一件事，这件事常常让我陷入麻烦，我觉得是我个人的问题。

sentences.en: It's, there's a process of normalizing queer people for America, and this movie does that.
sentences.zh: 就是，有一个为美国人将酷儿群体常态化的过程，而这部电影正是这样做的。

sentences.en: It makes the trans experience more understandable.
sentences.zh: 它让跨性别者的经历更容易被理解。

sentences.en: It's in a language, a comedy language that they know from Will and me.
sentences.zh: 它用的是一种他们从我和威尔身上熟知的喜剧语言。

sentences.en: It's a good project.
sentences.zh: 这是一个好项目。

sentences.en: It's representation in a good way.
sentences.zh: 这是以一种好的方式进行代表。

sentences.en: However, to be quite honest, I'm not that interested in normalizing for people who have hated me for centuries.
sentences.zh: 然而，老实说，我对向那些恨了我几个世纪的人寻求常态化并不那么感兴趣。

sentences.en: I don't want to sound mean, but I do want the movie to do that work.
sentences.zh: 我不想听起来很刻薄，但我确实希望这部电影能起这个作用。

sentences.en: I want it to make other people be gentler and softer and caring.
sentences.zh: 我希望它能让其他人变得更温和、更柔和、更有爱心。

sentences.en: And maybe if you're a father who loved Anchorman and you've got a trans kid, now maybe you're going to open yourself up to this.
sentences.zh: 也许如果你是一个喜欢《王牌播音员》的父亲，而你恰好有一个跨性别的小孩，现在你可能会对此敞开心扉。

sentences.en: Now you're willing to sit down and have a conversation.
sentences.zh: 现在你愿意坐下来好好谈谈了。

sentences.en: It's not a closed-off future.
sentences.zh: 未来并非封闭的。

sentences.en: There's a bright future ahead of you.
sentences.zh: 光明的未来在等着你。

sentences.en: I happen to think it's a better future.
sentences.zh: 我碰巧认为这是一个更好的未来。

sentences.en: But I think that's the work I want the movie to do.
sentences.zh: 但我想这就是我希望这部电影去完成的工作。

sentences.en: I don't necessarily care as much about, it's a, the conversation is too tricky for me, quite honestly.
sentences.zh: 我其实不怎么在乎，说实话，这个对话对我来说太棘手了。

sentences.en: But I don't particularly care about making myself normal to people who don't like me.
sentences.zh: 但我并不是特别在乎向那些不喜欢我的人证明我自己是正常的。

sentences.en: Near the end of the film, this is not a spoiler in any way.
sentences.zh: 在电影快结束时，这绝不算剧透。

sentences.en: Although I don't think it's really a spoiler type of film.
sentences.zh: 虽然我觉得它本来也不是那种靠剧透取胜的电影。

sentences.en: We get to California.
sentences.zh: 我们来到了加利福尼亚州。

sentences.en: The car doesn't break down.
sentences.zh: 车没有抛锚。

sentences.en: Spoiler!
sentences.zh: 剧透警告！

sentences.en: We discover oil, though.
sentences.zh: 不过我们发现了石油。

sentences.en: We discover oil in Beverly Hills.
sentences.zh: 我们在比弗利山庄发现了石油。

sentences.en: But you say towards the end of the film, Harper, I think the way you put it is, you should have transitioned 40 years ago.
sentences.zh: 但你在电影快结束时说，哈珀，我觉得你的原话是，你本该在40年前就完成跨性别转变的。

sentences.en: But if you had, none of your life would have happened the same way.
sentences.zh: 但如果你真的那样做了，你的人生就不会是现在这样了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Which is a very sort of profoundly ambivalent emotion.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常矛盾且深刻的情感。

sentences.en: And I'm just wondering if you could talk through it with me a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 我在想你能否跟我多聊聊这个。

sentences.en: How do you think about those two facets?
sentences.zh: 你是如何看待这两个方面的？

sentences.en: That's an ever-fluid situation.
sentences.zh: 这是一个永远在变化的情况。

sentences.en: I land on the side of good fortune of being able to come to this transition when I was 59.
sentences.zh: 我倾向于庆幸自己能在59岁时完成这次转变。

sentences.en: But, of course, there's a lot going on there.
sentences.zh: 但当然，其中包含了很多复杂的感受。

sentences.en: If one, if I transitioned when I was 20, my life would have been probably different, maybe wonderful, but probably tough.
sentences.zh: 如果一个人，如果我在20岁时就完成了转变，我的人生可能会完全不同，也许会很精彩，但也可能会非常艰难。

sentences.en: I don't think I would have gotten the opportunity to get a comedy job at Saturday Night Live eventually.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我最终可能不会有机会去《周六夜现场》做一份喜剧工作。

sentences.en: Or I think I would have been looked a little more on as an outlier, as a human.
sentences.zh: 或者我觉得人们作为一个独立的人，会更把我看作是一个异类。

sentences.en: But if I had transitioned into an environment like today, 40 years ago, yeah, I mean, of course.
sentences.zh: 但如果我在40年前就融入像今天这样的环境中，是的，当然。

sentences.en: Of course, I would have wanted to start my hormonal treatment at 16, you know.
sentences.zh: 当然，我肯定希望在16岁时就开始激素治疗，你知道的。

sentences.en: Yes, there are mornings where I wake up.
sentences.zh: 是的，有些早晨我醒来时。

sentences.en: Or when I see young trans people today and how easily they walk through the world, not everywhere, but in the coastal cities or something, there's a kind of jealousness there.
sentences.zh: 或者当我看到如今年轻的跨性别者以及他们在世界上行走时是多么轻松，虽说不是到处都这样，但在沿海城市或别的什么地方，心里确实会有一种嫉妒。

sentences.en: Like, oh, that would have been wonderful.
sentences.zh: 就像，哦，那该有多好啊。

sentences.en: Will, this is purely constructive criticism.
sentences.zh: 威尔，这纯粹是建设性的批评。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: In the film, you keep, you got this hankering for Dunkin' Donuts.
sentences.zh: 在电影里，你一直，你特别渴望去唐恩都乐（Dunkin' Donuts）。

sentences.en: Oh, boy.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: You keep pestering your friend about who's going through this emotional.
sentences.zh: 你一直缠着你那个正在经历情感波折的朋友。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Cutting to the core experience.
sentences.zh: 直击核心体验。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And you just fixate on you want your Dunkin' Donuts.
sentences.zh: 而你却只执着于你想吃唐恩都乐。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's insensitive.
sentences.zh: 这太麻木不仁了。

sentences.en: Just something for you to think about.
sentences.zh: 这只是给你的一点反思。

sentences.en: Well, can you answer that?
sentences.zh: 好吧，你能回答一下吗？

sentences.en: Why don't you walk in my shoes for a little while?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不设身处地为我着想一会儿呢？

sentences.en: You're on this trip.
sentences.zh: 你踏上了这趟旅程。

sentences.en: You've been nothing but accommodating to your friend.
sentences.zh: 你对你的朋友百依百顺。

sentences.en: You've gone everywhere she wanted to go.
sentences.zh: 她想去哪儿你都陪着去了。

sentences.en: You've done everything.
sentences.zh: 你做完了所有事。

sentences.en: Like, you've barely done anything you wanted to do at all.
sentences.zh: 就好像，你根本没做什么你想做的事。

sentences.en: And the one thing you wanted was Dunkin' Donuts?
sentences.zh: 而你唯一想做的事就是去邓肯甜甜圈？

sentences.en: I mean, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我不知道。

sentences.en: I think it was a small complaint.

sentences.zh: 当时我就想，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: And, uh, I'm really just trying to make Harper laugh.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，我其实只是想逗哈珀笑。

sentences.en: You're, you're forgetting a key element that I, that speaks to this perfectly.
sentences.zh: 你、你忘了一个关键元素，我，这完全印证了这一点。

sentences.en: Um, like taco town is a perfect example or unicorn mountain.
sentences.zh: 呃，比如“塔科镇”就是一个绝佳的例子，或者“独角兽山”。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Um, you don't know what these sketches are, by the way, for good reason.
sentences.zh: 呃，顺便说一句，你们不知道这些是什么短剧是有原因的。

sentences.en: Um, yes, I would write the first half and then hand it to Will and I wasn't allowed to see it.
sentences.zh: 呃，是的，我会写前半部分，然后交给威尔，而且我不被允许看它。

sentences.en: So I don't know what he's going to do with the sketch.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道他会怎么处理这个短剧。

sentences.en: It was always a left turn to David.
sentences.zh: 对大卫来说，这总是神来之笔。

sentences.en: Sorry, just for our benefit.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，为了我们好理解。

sentences.en: I just want to describe to you what unicorn mountain was about.
sentences.zh: 我只是想向你们描述一下“独角兽山”讲的是什么。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 请吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Unicorn mountain was a three page song that led off the sketch.
sentences.zh: “独角兽山”是一首三页纸的歌，作为短剧的开场。

sentences.en: And it was all about, it basically set the premise of like being a children's show.
sentences.zh: 它讲的全是，基本上奠定了儿童节目那种基调。

sentences.en: It's unicorn mountain where unicorns are, you know, live in unity and harmony and they bring joy and they're magical and they're fun.
sentences.zh: 这就是独角兽山，独角兽们，你知道的，生活在团结和谐中，它们带来快乐，充满魔力，而且很有趣。

sentences.en: And let's all go to unicorn mountain.
sentences.zh: 让我们一起去独角兽山吧。

sentences.en: And then we open on myself and Tracy Morgan and maybe I forget who else.
sentences.zh: 然后镜头切到我和特雷西·摩根，可能还有其他人，我记不清了。

sentences.en: And this is, this is Harper's house.
sentences.zh: 而这里是，这是哈珀的家。

sentences.en: And we're eating a unicorn and we're talking about how delicious the unicorn was and how easy it was to trap it and kill it because it was so benevolent and sweet and kind.
sentences.zh: 我们在吃一只独角兽，还讨论着独角兽有多美味，以及把它设陷阱抓住并杀死有多容易，因为它那么慈悲、甜美又善良。

sentences.en: And I felt a little bit bad when we killed it, but God, this is good unicorn.
sentences.zh: 我们杀了它的时候其实有点内疚，但天哪，这独角兽真好吃。

sentences.en: And now that's, you know, corn mountain.
sentences.zh: 然后这就是，你知道的，独角兽山。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So there's, I think I can detect a through line from the answers you gave to the film you just made.
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得我从你给出的回答中能看出一条贯穿你刚拍的那部电影的线索。

sentences.en: You know, you're on some level just trying to make the other guy laugh.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你在某种程度上只是想逗另一个人笑。

sentences.en: Oh, for sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是当然。

sentences.en: Say that again.
sentences.zh: 再说一遍。

sentences.en: Make the other girl or guy laugh.
sentences.zh: 逗另一个女孩或男孩笑。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: Don't worry.
sentences.zh: 别担心。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: It's just a, it's a verbal tick I have that I need to solve.
sentences.zh: 这只是个，我改不掉的口头禅。

sentences.en: But you know, it's like, I have two daughters.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，就像，我有两个女儿。

sentences.en: I say like, come over here, guys.
sentences.zh: 我会说，过来这里，伙计们。

sentences.en: You know, it's, I apologize.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是，我道歉。

sentences.en: Please don't worry about that.
sentences.zh: 请不要担心这个。

sentences.en: I say guys all the time.
sentences.zh: 我总是说“伙计们”。

sentences.en: Dudes, bros, those are a little bit more transgressive, but guys is something.
sentences.zh: 兄弟们、老铁们，这些稍微有点越界，但“伙计们”这种称呼……

sentences.en: I mean, I say it to my kids and they're all girls.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我对我的孩子们也这么说，她们全都是女孩。

sentences.en: See, look what happened.
sentences.zh: 你看，瞧这事闹的。

sentences.en: You have my girl.
sentences.zh: 你有我的女孩。

sentences.en: One of them today then.
sentences.zh: 那其中一个今天就……

sentences.en: So here we go.
sentences.zh: 所以我们开始吧。

sentences.en: It's a universal experience.
sentences.zh: 这是一种普遍的体验。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So the movie really paints this lovely picture of your friendship as continued support and closeness.
sentences.zh: 所以这部电影确实把你们的友谊描绘成了一幅美好的画卷，充满了持续的支持与亲密感。

sentences.en: But there must be some way in which this experience has changed your friendship because all friendships change over time.
sentences.zh: 但这段经历肯定在某种程度上改变了你们的友谊，因为所有的友谊随时间推移都会改变。

sentences.en: I think.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, change isn't always easy.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，改变并不总是容易的。

sentences.en: Has anything about sort of your shared experience challenged or, or evolved your ideas about what friendship is or what it can be?
sentences.zh: 你们的某种共同经历，有没有挑战或演变过你们对友谊是什么、或者友谊可以是什么的看法？

sentences.en: I think a lot of my friendships, there was an element of fear.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我的很多友谊中，都存在着某种恐惧成分。

sentences.en: And the biggest change for me is that I'm not afraid of my friends.
sentences.zh: 对我来说最大的改变是，我不再害怕我的朋友了。

sentences.en: And I think that's pretty huge.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这相当了不起。

sentences.en: So for someone who's hiding something like I was transitioning can open up a world that I just didn't live in.
sentences.zh: 所以，对于像我这样隐藏着某些秘密的人来说，转型可以开启一个我以前从未涉足的世界。

sentences.en: That was a big change for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我是个巨大的改变。

sentences.en: I mean, it brought us closer for sure.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这确实让我们更亲密了。

sentences.en: There's no question for the entire time that we've known each other, we never talked as deeply or intensely as we did those 17 days.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，在我们认识的整段时光里，我们从未像在那17天里那样进行过如此深刻或强烈的交流。

sentences.en: So that's, without a doubt, you know, a change there.
sentences.zh: 所以毫无疑问，你知道，那是一个改变。

sentences.en: You know, I mean, we're about to go through an intense period of press, of reflection, of
sentences.zh: 你知道，我是说，我们即将经历一段激烈的宣传期、反思期、

sentences.en: analysis over all this stuff.
sentences.zh: 对所有这些事情的剖析。

sentences.en: And at the end, maybe Harper might go, I hate you.
sentences.zh: 到最后，也许哈珀会说，我恨你。

sentences.en: Now I hate you for dragging me through all this.
sentences.zh: 现在我恨你拉着我经历这一切。

sentences.en: France, we are no longer France, which my comedy brain says at the end of this, we should announce we're no longer France.
sentences.zh: 法国，我们不再是法国了，我的喜剧大脑告诉我，在这个结尾，我们应该宣布我们不再是法国了。

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't think it's a maybe.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得这不是“也许”。
